# Messi vs Ronaldo

> > Comprehensive statistical comparison of Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo's career achievements across all competitions and clubs.

This site provides detailed career statistics, team trophies, and performance metrics for football legends Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo. It covers their achievements across clubs including Barcelona, Real Madrid, Manchester United, Juventus, Paris Saint-Germain, and Inter Miami, as well as competitions like the Champions League, La Liga, Premier League, Serie A, and international tournaments.

## Key Topics

- Lionel Messi
- Cristiano Ronaldo
- Champions League
- Career statistics comparison
- Team trophies and honours
- Goals and assists
- Real Madrid
- Barcelona
- Manchester United
- Penalty statistics
- Non-penalty goals
- International titles
- Club achievements
- Football performance metrics
- Trophy comparison

## Career Overview

- [Messi vs Ronaldo - All Time Career Goals and Stats](https://www.messivsronaldo.app/): Homepage comparing Messi vs Ronaldo career goals, assists, and statistics

## Team Trophies and Honours

- [Team Trophies, Honours and Achievements - Messi vs Ronaldo All Team Trophies](https://www.messivsronaldo.app/honours-and-achievements/): Compares Messi and Ronaldo's team trophies including league and Champions League

## Detailed Statistics

- [Penalties - Messi and Ronaldo All Time Penalty Goals, Misses and Penalty Conversion Rates](https://www.messivsronaldo.app/detailed-stats/penalties/): Detailed penalty stats: goals, misses, and conversion rates for both players
- [Non-penalty Goals - Messi vs Ronaldo All Goals Without Penalties](https://www.messivsronaldo.app/detailed-stats/goals-without-penalties/): Goal comparison excluding penalties for Messi and Ronaldo across competitions

## Articles and Analysis

- [Built, Not Born: How Cristiano Ronaldo Engineered Himself Into a Living Legend](https://www.messivsronaldo.app/articles/built-not-born-how-cristiano-ronaldo-engineered-himself-into-living-legend/): Article on Ronaldo's discipline, training methods, and career development
